about: PLACEHOLDER TEACHERS FOR THE TEST PHASE ONLY. The owner, 4 Oct 2026 12:54: "make up [the teachers], because we are in the test phase" (D19). Every person and every result below is invented: the names are the design's own four teachers (Aziza Karimova, Javlon Tursunov, Kamila Saidova, Bekzod Aliev, with the design's subjects and illustrated avatars) and one more in the same style (Feruza Nazarova), and the past students are invented first names with an initial. No real JIA or Jamals Admissions person, student or photograph is used (tests/unit/engine/teachers.test.ts). Replace this file with the real roster (name, subject, photo, bio, past students' results with consent) before any real family is invited (docs/ai/CURRENT_STATE.md, launch gate).

bio.en: Eight years of SAT Math. She starts every topic with the question types the test repeats, then practises them with you until they are quick.
bio.uz: Sakkiz yildan beri SAT matematikasidan dars beradi. Har bir mavzuni test takrorlaydigan savol turlaridan boshlaydi va ularni tez yechadigan boʻlguningizcha siz bilan mashq qiladi.
bio.ru: Восемь лет преподаёт математику SAT. Каждую тему начинает с типов вопросов, которые повторяются в тесте, и тренирует их с вами, пока вы не начнёте решать быстро.

bio.en: Five years of SAT Reading and Writing. She teaches you to find the line that proves an answer before you choose it.
bio.uz: Besh yildan beri SAT oʻqish va yozish boʻlimidan dars beradi. Javobni tanlashdan oldin uni isbotlaydigan qatorni topishni oʻrgatadi.
bio.ru: Пять лет преподаёт чтение и письмо SAT. Учит находить в тексте строку, которая доказывает ответ, прежде чем его выбрать.

subject.uz: AP: matematik analiz, fizika va kimyo
subject.ru: AP: математический анализ, физика и химия

bio.en: Six years of AP Calculus and Physics, and Chemistry for those who need it. He also leads the robotics club.
bio.uz: Olti yildan beri AP matematik analiz va fizikadan, kerak boʻlganlarga kimyodan ham dars beradi. Robototexnika toʻgaragini ham boshqaradi.
bio.ru: Шесть лет преподаёт AP по математическому анализу и физике, а тем, кому нужно, и химию. Ещё ведёт кружок робототехники.

bio.en: Seven years of IELTS. She shows you how to plan an essay in two minutes, and runs a speaking club every Sunday.
bio.uz: Yetti yildan beri IELTSdan dars beradi. Inshoni ikki daqiqada rejalashtirishni oʻrgatadi va har yakshanba speaking klubini olib boradi.
bio.ru: Семь лет преподаёт IELTS. Учит планировать эссе за две минуты и каждое воскресенье ведёт разговорный клуб.

bio.en: Five years of teaching psychology: how we learn, and how to learn better.
bio.uz: Besh yildan beri psixologiyadan dars beradi: qanday oʻrganamiz va qanday qilib yaxshiroq oʻrganish mumkin.
bio.ru: Пять лет преподаёт психологию: как мы учимся и как учиться лучше.
